report.title: Health fixture privacy-hardening pass
report.goal: Remove real personal Oura aggregates from the client-side health fixture bundle and ensure the UI cannot be mistaken for a personal analysis.

summary: Replaced all personal Oura aggregates in healthFixtures with clearly synthetic round values.
Set every metric baseline to null and status to gray; dataConfidence to insufficient.
Updated trend points to synthetic round values.
Rewrote finding text to state that all data is synthetic/demo.
Changed dataQuality source to 'Synthetic fixture', coverageDays to 0, syncStatus to demo.
Strengthened demoNote and added isDemo/synthetic markers.
Removed 'Oura', 'личный baseline' and 'данные актуальны' wording from the UI.
Added statusHeadline gray case for demo state.
Evidence paper citations kept; fixture MCP provenance remains synthetic placeholder only.

real_oura_aggregates_in_fixture.note: No real personal values (HRV 13, RHR 71, sleep 62, readiness 82, activity 88, steps 11581, SpO₂ 93.6, sleep_duration 56) remain in healthFixtures or trend points.

synthetic_markers.note: All fixtures have isDemo=true, demoNote includes synthetic/демо warning, generatedAt is 2099-01-01T00:00:00Z.

baseline_null_and_gray.note: Every metric has null baseline and gray status; fixture finding status is gray.

medical_thresholds_and_claims.note: No medical thresholds or personal clinical claims are made. UI states it is not a diagnosis or triage.

mcp_provenance.note: Fixture provenance uses synthetic TEST_MCP_TOOL/test_toolkit/test-log-id-placeholder. Real MCP provenance stays only in prior local report, not in client fixture.

xss_and_accessibility.note: No dangerouslySetInnerHTML. All rendered strings come from static fixtures or translated labels. Evidence links are rendered as plain text, not clickable hrefs. Existing aria-labels/roles preserved; new statusHeadline supports gray state.

bundle_leak_check.note: Scanned .output/public/assets *.js/*.css after build:dev; no banned personal-fact substrings found.

secrets_and_pii.note: No email, tokens, .env, credentials, nginx/systemd/gateway/auth changes in this pass.

unit_tests.command: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/lib/auth/gate-identity.test.ts src/components/health/health-mock.test.ts src/lib/finance/rates.test.ts src/lib/hub/actions.test.ts src/lib/hub/gateway.test.ts src/lib/reminders/parse.test.ts src/lib/server/backup-auth.test.ts src/lib/openclaw/bot-access.test.ts src/lib/weather/forecast.test.ts

build_dev.command: node scripts/with-app-env.mjs node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --mode development
build_dev.note: Wrapper only merges VITE_ build flags; no production deploy or auth/env changes.

next_steps: When real local Oura aggregates are reintroduced, route them through a server-side DTO and keep raw rows out of the client bundle.
Persist real MCP provenance in a private report only, never in healthFixtures.
